verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab is described first-party as open source, and the community independently reports that Isaac GR00T N1 was released under Apache 2. A public isaac-sim/IsaacSim GitHub repository also exists. The evidence never states which license covers Isaac Sim, Isaac ROS or Isaac Lab, so open-source readability is confirmed for only part of the platform. Missing for 10: named licenses for Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab and Isaac ROS; evidence that the Isaac Sim repo contains readable core source rather than only feature descriptions; independent corroboration beyond GR00T.
